title: Harness selection and execution
intro: First-release design, reviewed in harness-selection-and-execution-k9 and repaired in k10; nothing here is implemented. The human chose the original-creator mechanism; its details are design decisions, not human approvals. These are source-package and process views, not deployment containers. Graphs begin at a dark Start here node; sequence views begin at the first message.

groups.title: Package boundary
groups.description: One public command, an installed private worker, optional caller adapters.

groups.title: Execution and authority
groups.description: Selection ends before the foreground process becomes the harness.

groups.title: Original creator and review
groups.description: A review carries a reference to its creator's run; run records outlive the task tree.

discussion.title: A review carries its creator reference
discussion.status: Chosen by the human; reviewed, and its lifecycle rules repaired
discussion.summary: The producer's finishing session writes a Creator line naming its dispatch run on its review leaf, and the supplied policy reads that immutable run's provider; an artifact without a run carries the owner's declaration. The scope, its slot and commands, the inode tripwire and creator registration are gone. The methodology amendments this needs ship with the dispatch implementation.

updatedDiagrams.summary: New: compares where each option keeps the creator's provider and which standing rule it amends; option A is chosen.

Traces the chosen mechanism from the producer's launch to the review's provider check. Repaired: the finishing session also updates reviews of each node its close cascade closes, and removes the line when it ran without dispatch.
Replaced registration lookup with the Creator line, the fail-closed review recognition (F3) and the catalog membership check (F4).
Corrected the adapter label: it reads only the supplied task file, as integration decided for F5.

diagrams.title: Caller, dispatcher and policy packages
diagrams.caption: Source packages and runtime participants. Grove-specific relationship parsing belongs to the optional adapter; the generic command has no review-kind list.

diagrams.title: Prepare, record and replace the foreground process
diagrams.caption: The worker shares the enclosing job and receives no interactive stdin. Cancellation or timeout before admission launches nothing. Post-exec measurements require an external observer.

diagrams.title: Where each option keeps the creator's provider
diagrams.caption: Decided: the human chose A. A lookup keyed by handle must tell this grove's handle from an earlier grove's in the same workspace, which needs durable state Grove deliberately lacks (B). A globally unique run reference carried by the review needs none (A).

diagrams.title: Producer names its run; the review resolves it
diagrams.caption: The run reference is written by the session that ran under it, so the provider comes from dispatch's immutable record rather than a transcription. The association itself is that session's attestation, not verified. A session that finishes without a run removes any earlier line, and the owner declares the finished artifact's provider.

diagrams.title: Resolve the Creator line before selecting a reviewer
diagrams.caption: The supplied example policy. Every invocation, retry and explicit choice takes the same path; a retry reads the same line and the same immutable run, so it cannot change the creator.
